findings.finding: Each state and payload is validated independently, but their dimensions, pitch and initialized extent are never bound to one another. Full load accepts P5 state40x40 with payload80x40, marking requiredStateComplete/identityVerified true.
findings.fix: For every exact state/payload pair require safe integer dimensions, payload.width/height===state.width/height, sourcePitch===state.iwidth*8, packedPitch===state.width*channels*2, and expected payload span within validated declared allocation. Reject before returning capture.
findings.syntheticEvidence: F2 full loader accepts P5 state40x40 with payload80x40

findings.finding: CIELab/allhex have only an upper boundary before serial payload, and P8/out_cam only before P9. The loader accepts P8/out_cam before P1; typed validator accepts allhex before P1.
findings.fix: Bind indexed windows P5 payload < CIELab initialization/tables < allhex < serial-ready state/payload < P6 state/payload, and P7 payload < P8 state < its typed rows/out_cam < P9 state/payload. Bind histogram after P9 payload and before P10. Keep the existing primary order and uniqueness checks.
findings.syntheticEvidence: F3 full loader accepts P8/out_cam before P1; F3 allhex before P1 accepted

findings.finding: The complete positive schema contains zero actual-xtrans-passes/T/ndir, omp runtime scalars or tile records and still passes. Runtime evidence being mandatory in the generator does not make it mandatory in the offline reader.
findings.fix: Require exactly one actual-xtrans-passes/T/ndir record bound to the XTrans serial window and at least one valid tile for this supported large-frame path; validate team/worker/tile geometry/scratch extent and compile-conditional omp runtime records. Keep worker scheduling out of semantic pixel equality and H1 UNKNOWN without consumer-load evidence.
findings.syntheticEvidence: F2 no tile/runtime xtrans metadata accepted
